title: storage-status output
description: File written by storage-status.py. Sizes are in bytes, times are Unix timestamps or hours. A field is null when the value is unknown.

schema_version.description: Incremented on incompatible changes. New fields can appear without a new version.

generated_at.description: When the file was written, ISO 8601 with the NAS time zone offset.

generated_epoch.description: Same moment as generated_at, as a Unix timestamp. Added in 1.2.0.

thresholds.description: Free space thresholds used for space_status and cloud status (WARN_PCT and CRIT_PCT). Added in 1.2.0.

errors.description: Sections that could not be collected (pools, cloud, cloud_sync, snapshots), with the error. The section is then empty or partial; the script exits with status 1. Added in 1.2.0.

cloud_sync.description: Last run of every cloud sync task, by task description (a repeated description gets the task id in brackets). Added in 1.2.0.

state.description: State of the last job: SUCCESS, FAILED, ABORTED, RUNNING or WAITING; null if the task never ran since the job history was cleared.

age_hours.description: Hours since the last run finished.

error.description: Error of the last run, at most 300 characters.

pools.description: Every pool returned by pool.query, by pool name. The boot pool is not included.

status.description: Pool status from TrueNAS, e.g. ONLINE, DEGRADED, OFFLINE.

space_status.description: OK, LOW (free_pct below warn_pct) or CRITICAL (below crit_pct); null when free_pct is unknown. Added in 1.2.0.

healthy.description: TrueNAS verdict on the pool (status, errors, scan results). Added in 1.1.0.

scan.description: Last scrub or resilver; ZFS keeps only the most recent one. Null if the pool was never scanned. Added in 1.1.0.

age_hours.description: Hours since the scan ended, null while running.

disks.description: Every disk of the pool. Added in 1.1.0.

name.description: Device name (e.g. sda), or the vdev name if the disk is missing.

role.description: vdev group: data, cache, log, spare, special or dedup.

status.description: e.g. ONLINE, DEGRADED, FAULTED, UNAVAIL, REMOVED.

cloud.description: Cloud credentials that report their space (OneDrive and Google Drive), by credential name. Other providers are skipped.

status.description: OK; LOW below warn_pct free (default 20); CRITICAL below crit_pct free (default 10); ERROR when rclone could not read the space.

error.description: Only with status ERROR: the exception type.

snapshot_space.description: Space used by snapshots (sum of usedbysnapshots), by pool name. Includes the boot pool.

snapshots.description: One entry per dataset with an enabled periodic snapshot task, by dataset name. Several tasks on the same dataset are merged.

recursive.description: True if at least one task is recursive.

count.description: Snapshots of the dataset itself whose name matches a task naming schema; manual snapshots are not counted.

bytes.description: usedbysnapshots of the dataset and, if recursive, of its children, minus excluded datasets.

last.description: Name of the newest snapshot (after the @), null if there is none yet.

last_epoch.description: Creation time of the newest snapshot.

age_hours.description: Age of the newest snapshot when the file was written.
